description: Deletes one commitment and every charge it ever had, by id. This is destructive; cancel_commitment keeps what happened instead. Writes are schema-validated and provenance-stamped, and land in the app's Proposals screen where the owner keeps or undoes the whole batch. Card numbers, CVVs and credentials are refused by the validator, which names the row. `source` ("documents/hdfc-2026.pdf", "gmail:18c2…") records where a row came from in the diff.

guide_key.description: The guide_key read_guide returned with the prompt or chapter this write follows.

id.description: The commitment id, from commitments or search. By id only, never by name.

name: delete_commitment
title: Delete a commitment
